audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer showed 'Skill' at Level 6, First item and 2+ items while the content layer showed Taliyah, Aurelion Sol, Aurelion Sol.
audit.why: Three rows rendered two different answers. The packet chart (Taliyah 1-5, Aurelion Sol 6-7) matches the content layer and the 51.1% owner win rate over 182 games.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side = Taliyah, phases[5].side = Aurelion Sol, phases[6].side = Aurelion Sol.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Aurelion Sol's ultimate 'Voice of Light'.
audit.why: That ability does not exist in his kit. His R is Falling Star (120/110/100), upgrading to The Skies Descend at enough Stardust. It is a stun, not a poke tool, so 'comparable poke range' misdescribes the level 6 spike. Taliyah's spikes are 3 points of Q (7/6/5/4/3), and Weaver's Wall at 6 on 180/150/120 with 2500/4500/6500 range.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Falling Star as a stun answer to her setup; her 6 is a roam spike, not a lane spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real interactions absent: her CC cancelling your channels, and Astral Flight ignoring Weaver's Wall.
audit.why: Breath of Light (Q) and Astral Flight (W) are interruptible channels; Threaded Volley (Q), Unraveled Earth (E) and Weaver's Wall (R) all carry hard CC and end either one. Conversely Riot's Astral Flight text states he flies over terrain, so Weaver's Wall cannot wall him off the way it does other mids. Unraveled Earth only stuns targets that dash through it or are knocked through it, so her W-into-E is the sequence to sidestep.
audit.corrected: Channel only after her E/W are spent; use Astral Flight to cross her ultimate wall instead of walking around it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is a template with no numbers.
audit.why: Threaded Volley drops to 3s at rank 5, Seismic Shove 14/12.5/11/9.5/8 and free at rank 5, Unraveled Earth flat 14s, Weaver's Wall 180/150/120.
audit.corrected: Grounded on E as the punishable cooldown, not Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] says Worked Ground sets up 'empowered W knockups'.
audit.why: Worked Ground empowers Threaded Volley (a stronger, slowing boulder), not Seismic Shove. The real setup is W shoving you into Unraveled Earth.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the W-into-E stun sequence.

edits.before: Voice of Light gives you comparable range, letting you finally trade back and contest priority
edits.after: Falling Star gives you a stun she has to respect, letting you trade back and contest priority

edits.before: Weaver's Wall lets her navigate terrain and roam faster than almost anyone, but this is exactly when Voice of Light comes online for you, finally giving you comparable poke range to trade back.
edits.after: Weaver's Wall roams 2500 units on a 180s cooldown at rank 1, but this is exactly when Falling Star comes online for you — and Astral Flight flies over terrain, so her wall never boxes you in.

edits.before: Level 6 brings you back into the fight — Voice of Light finally gives you comparable poke range, letting you start answering her Q rotation instead of just absorbing it. Keep an eye on her ultimate cooldown for roam timing, and use your own range advantage to contest priority rather than let her freely zone you.
edits.after: Level 6 brings you back into the fight — Falling Star stuns her out of the Seismic Shove setup instead of you absorbing the Q rotation forever. Weaver's Wall is 180s at rank 1, so track it for her roam timing, and remember Astral Flight flies over terrain, so the wall never traps you. Contest priority rather than let her zone you off the wave.

edits.before: After level 6, poke aggressively with R since your range starts to match hers
edits.after: After level 6, hold Falling Star for her step-up — it is a stun, not poke

edits.before: Poke with Q on cooldown and rock the ground to set up empowered W knockups
edits.after: Poke with Q, then Seismic Shove you into Unraveled Earth for the stun

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Astral Flight has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Unraveled Earth is a flat 14s and only stuns what gets knocked or dashed into it — with her E spent, Seismic Shove is just a reposition. - Threaded Volley falls to 3s by rank 5; a dodged Q is never a window. - Astral Flight has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Watch the minefield, not the shove — Unraveled Earth is the stun, and it is a flat 14s. With it down, her W just moves you.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Taliyah for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Black-hole the back casters and let the execute finish them from 750 range — you bank stardust without stepping into her 1000-range Threaded Volley line.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Her Q, E and R all carry CC that ends the beam mid-channel — start it only after one of them is spent.

edits.before: If Taliyah gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Seismic Shove extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Taliyah gets a kill, expect her to leave: Weaver's Wall turns a lead into three lanes of pressure, so ping it and match with a Teleport. Two kills: stop dueling — clear with E executes and keep banking stardust.

notes: 'Voice of Light' is a fabricated ability name and appeared in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid — Aurelion Sol's R is Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Three level-chart disagreements fixed as a group: phases[4].side, phases[5].side and phases[6].side all read 'Skill' against the content layer and the packet chart. Rock Surfing gives Taliyah move speed near walls, and Astral Flight creates terrain — whether his own flight terrain feeds her passive is not stated in Riot's text, so it was not written to the page.
